pr_title: Renderer: add PBR material texture contract
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues the generic renderer PBR material foundation. Corrects the MikkTSpace generated-tangent regression test to match the engine's right-handed bitangent reconstruction contract while preserving the production tangent conversion.

## Validation

Windows Validation is dispatched by the trusted GameEngine dispatcher. The branch still contains Cargo.lock changes, so full workspace validation is expected.
